children: T1 Energy Inc. (TE) filed a Form 8K - Regulation FD Disclosure - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on November 12, 2026.

The Company is furnishing its earnings call presentation for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 (the "Presentation"), attached as Exhibit 99.2 to this Current Report on Form 8-K, which may be referred to on the Company's conference call for the financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 to be held on November 12, 2026. The Presentation will also be available on the Company's website at https://www.t1energy.com.

The information in this Item 7.01, including the Exhibit 99.2 attached hereto, is being furnished and shall not be deemed "filed" for purposes of Section 18 of the Exchange Act, nor shall it be deemed incorporated by reference in any filing under the Securities Act, except as shall be expressly set forth by specific reference in such filing.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1992243/000121390026118327/ea0311994-8k_t1energy.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1992243/000121390026118327/0001213900-26-118327-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
